title: Generating New Coordination Compounds via Multireference Simulations, Genetic Algorithms, and Machine Learning: The Case of Co(II) and Dy(III) Molecular Magnets.
summary: The original ACS Methods/Results combine multireference simulations, genetic search and ML prescreening to identify specific high-anisotropy Co(II)/Dy(III) coordination candidates. Admit narrowly as computationally supported molecular-magnet candidates; they were not experimentally synthesized/tested in this study.
